2607.15560.title: Evolutionary Algorithm-Guided LLMs for Physics-Informed Neural Network Design
2607.15560.paper_summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are unusually sensitive to interacting choices of architecture, activation, loss weighting, collocation, optimization, and constraint enforcement. Large language models (LLMs) can propose these choices, but independent recommendations do not accumulate experience from previously trained PINNs. We propose a closed-loop evolutionary algorithm that guides an LLM to generate complete, executable PINN configurations across generations, using measured training outcomes to determine subsequent search decisions. The algorithm maintains an evaluated population and lineage, applies parent-conditioned mutation and crossover, preserves elite and diverse solutions, rejects effective duplicates, and converts parent-relative successes and failures into the next-generation context supplied to the LLM. Every proposed configuration is executed directly under an exact optimizer-step budget. On a one-dimensional multiscale wave equation, two independent ten-generation runs trained 60 PINNs for 600,000 optimizer steps. In both runs, the best configuration appeared in the final generation, with best mean-squared error reduced by 2.97\% and 95.38\% relative to the initial population. The stronger run validated residual connections and increased depth on separate branches, combined them in a later generation, and then refined width and collocation density. It also revealed that low solution error can coexist with a high PDE residual. These results demonstrate the feasibility of evolutionary-algorithm-guided LLMs for PINN design on a controlled PDE while motivating broader, physics-aware evaluation.
2607.15560.paper_summary_zh: 物理知識驅動的神經網絡（PINNs）對於架構、激活、損失加權、協同位置、優化和約束執行的交互選擇異常敏感。大型語言模型（LLMs）可以提出這些選擇，但獨立的建議並不會從先前訓練的PINNs中累積經驗。我們提出了一種閉環進化算法，指導LLM生成完整的、可執行的PINN配置，跨越世代，利用測量的訓練結果來決定後續的搜索決策。該算法維持一個經評估的人口和血統，應用父母條件變異和交叉，保留精英和多樣化的解，拒絕有效的重複，並將父母相對的成功與失敗轉換為供LLM使用的下一代上下文。每個提議的配置都在確切的優化器步驟預算下直接執行。在一維多尺度波方程上，兩次獨立的十代運行訓練了60個PINNs，進行了600,000個優化器步驟。在這兩次運行中，最佳配置出現在最後一代，最佳均方誤差相對於初始人口減少了2.97\%和95.38\%。較強的運行驗證了殘差連接並在不同分支上增加了深度，將它們在後來的一代中結合，然後細化寬度和協同位置密度。它還顯示出低解決方案誤差可以與高PDE殘差共存。這些結果展示了進化算法引導的LLMs在受控PDE上進行PINN設計的可行性，同時激勵更廣泛的、物理知識驅動的評估。
